comment: Awesome professor and great lectures. Felt like I learned a lot from this class and Professor Castro was also very flexible and caring! Would definitely recommend his class.

Professor Castro is one of the best professors I've had at Richmond so far! His lectures are incredibly engaging and thought-provoking; they make the 2.5 hour classes go by fast. He gives weekly quizzes, a couple presentations, a midterm and a final. It is clear Professor Castro genuinely wants to see his students succeed.

Professor Castro is amazing! The class was once a week and 2.5 hours, but Professor Castro did a great job of keeping us engaged by using videos and giving lots of insight to his own profession. 2 short presentations, weekly quizzes, midterm and final, and participation make up your grade, make sure to ask questions, and enjoy taking his class!

Took the late class from 6-8:45PM every Tuesday, and while I was intimidated by this long chunk of time in the beginning I ended up loving it - don't be intimidated by it. Weekly quizzes, one midterm, 1 cumulative final. Dr.Castro is the most thoughtful professor I've ever had, he really cares about his students and is respected by everyone 10/10

Dr Castro is a kind professor who wants his students to succeed. His lectures were interesting and filled with real-world examples from health policy in Virginia. Weekly blackboard quizzes that are very fair and not time consuming, 2 quick presentations, and midterm and final (very fair). Loved the class and would definitely take him again.

I have no words to describe how extraordinary this professor is. He cares about students, knows how they feel, and does his best to help them understand a topic. He is the best professor I have ever had and has my respect. I will never forget him. He is extremely experienced, and I noticed that he loves teaching. Thank you very much, Mr. Castro.

Professor Castro is easily one of the best professors I've ever had. He's so transparent and wicked cool.  He's very honest in his lectures and clear when it comes to grading and assignments. I couldn't say a bad thing about him if I wanted to.  I wish he was a full time professor because he's just that good.

Dr. Castro is an amazing professor and is very knowledgeable about Health Systems and Policy. His lectures are intriguing and always leave me learning so much information! I would recommend his class to anyone. Hands down one of the best professors I have had at UR.
